newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Lithuanian shares mixed, Hermis Bank in spotlight.
newsitem.headline: Lithuanian shares mixed, Hermis Bank in spotlight.

text.p: Hermis Bank kept the Vilnius bourse relatively active on Thursday, accounting for over half of central market turnover in a day of mixed trading.
Official list shares eased 4.63 points to 939.64 points, while the broader group A list advanced 5.82 points to 1838.24 points.
Hermis held steady at 210 litas and dominated trading, with 447,000 litas of the central market's 744,000 litas turnover.
"Maybe next week it will reach 215 litas," said one broker. "Many shareholders have sold what they wanted to and they'll wait to see what happens."
Brokers say Hermis may gain on Vilnius Bank, which was unchanged at 245 litas amid central market turnover of 17,640 litas.
Medienos Plaushas, one of three corporates on the official list, dropped to 11.80 litas amid thin central market turnover.
The company said on Thursday its profits for the first six months were 1.8 million litas, up from 1.3 million litas in the same period last year but shy of the 2 million litas it had projected.
Brokers say the fall came too early in the day to be influenced by the result, which they said would have minimal impact on its price anyway.

Dealers remained uncertain about the short-term prospects for the market, which has been laid low by summer and nervous local investors, who have been scared off by a long-term correction which set in after shares surged to new highs early in the year.
